title: execution_reserve output
description: Reserve one execution before calling the provider and get the execution grant the provider redeems before it starts the work. On a paid plan the run takes a call of a pack you already bought, or, with none left, buys the next pack: its price is held against every budget that applies and on your organization's wallet, and paid only when the run succeeds; requested_max_amount_atoms must cover it. BALANCE_LOW when the wallet doesn't cover it. A retry with the same execution_id returns the same reservation.
